title: Component catalog pages teach the canonical controls they spec
notes: From ux-audit rescan 2026-08-23 ('comp-* catalog'). Pages: comp-agent, comp-buttons, comp-feedback, comp-fields, comp-index, comp-overlays, comp-panels, comp-segmented, comp-toolbars, comp-tooltips, layers-pane, panes-panels. Key items: comp-overlays sheet figure becomes a real data-shell window (high); comp-agent drops fake traffic-dot mini-windows and restates the conversation as the right-dock Agent group per the one-dock model; comp-index inventory on .libgrid/.libtile; comp-toolbars/comp-buttons/comp-index retire .pill.ai in favor of .askbtn; comp-tooltips .ct-strip to .tbar/.tstrip; comp-feedback toast from the shared toast component; comp-segmented real .btn + .slider in demos; comp-fields ic-arrow-right + real .dgrp inspector column; comp-panels real .pdock in the demo; layers-pane/panes-panels replace inert .bar meters with .setrow/.slrow + add the missing .tbar in panes-panels' full shells; rename .hero collisions. Verify 200 + audit-sweep.
